subject: Matematik 1
title: Relationships and change
sourceSummary: The equation of a straight line, the slope and intercept in real-world contexts, and the difference between linear and exponential change.
topics: the equation of a straight line

questions.topic: the equation of a straight line
questions.prompt: A straight line passes through the points $(1, 3)$ and $(3, 11)$. What is the slope $k$?
questions.opener: The slope is the change in $y$ divided by the change in $x$.

questions.topic: the equation of a straight line
questions.prompt: A line has slope $-2$ and crosses the y-axis at $(0, 5)$. What is the equation of the line?
questions.opener: Substitute $k$ and $m$ into the general form.
questions.explanation: The equation of a straight line is $y = kx + m$ with $k = -2$ and $m = 5$, so $y = -2x + 5$.

questions.topic: the equation of a straight line
questions.prompt: Where does the line $y = 2x - 6$ cross the x-axis?
questions.opener: What is $y$ at every point on the x-axis?
questions.explanation: On the x-axis, $y = 0$: $0 = 2x - 6$ gives $2x = 6$ and $x = 3$, so the point $(3, 0)$. The point $(0, -6)$ is where the line crosses the y-axis.

questions.prompt: A tradesperson charges a 300 kr call-out fee plus 450 kr per hour: $y = 450x + 300$. What does the number 450 represent?
questions.opener: Which of the numbers changes with the number of hours?
choices: The cost of a full day
questions.explanation: The slope, 450, is the change per unit — in other words, the cost per hour. The intercept, 300, is the fixed call-out fee charged regardless of time.

questions.prompt: Which of these describes an exponential change?
questions.opener: The difference lies in whether you add the same amount, or multiply by the same amount.
choices: The value decreases by 3% per year
The temperature drops 2 degrees per hour
The distance increases by 60 km per hour
The salary increases by 500 kr per month
questions.explanation: Exponential change means the value is multiplied by the same factor every period (here $0.97$). The other options add or subtract a fixed amount, which is linear.

questions.prompt: A deposit of 5,000 kr grows by 4% per year. Which expression gives the amount after $n$ years?
questions.opener: What is the amount multiplied by each year?
questions.explanation: Each year the amount is multiplied by the change factor $1.04$, so after $n$ years: $5000 \cdot 1.04^n$.

questions.prompt: A gym has two options: A costs a 500 kr joining fee plus 200 kr/month. B costs a 900 kr joining fee plus 150 kr/month. After how many months do they cost the same?
questions.opener: Write an equation for each option and set them equal.
steps: Divide by 50: $x = 8$ months. Both then cost $200 \cdot 8 + 500 = 2{,}100$ kr (check: $150 \cdot 8 + 900 = 2{,}100$ kr).
After 8 months, B is cheaper, since B has a lower monthly cost.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between linear and exponential change?
questions.opener: One of them is about addition, the other about multiplication.
questions.answer: Linear change: the same amount is added (or subtracted) every period — the graph is a straight line, of the form $y = kx + m$. Exponential change: the value is multiplied by the same factor every period — the graph curves increasingly steeply (or flattens out), of the form $y = C \cdot a^x$. Percentage change is always exponential.
